title: CI: validate evals/trigger/** (query sets and results)
description: Follow-up from the PSKI-9 verdict (opum-doc, claude-opus-5-5): CI does not read evals/trigger/**. Low priority, not blocking, per the operator's 2026-10-05 ruling against a hardening spiral. Candidate shape: a check that each evals/trigger/<skill>.json parses, has 10 true and 10 false entries, and that each committed results file's original_description equals the committed SKILL.md. CI workflows are DEC-182 floor work: needs a plan word and its own arrangement before starting. Not started.
